title: Amber Marshall Reveals the 1 Thing She Loves About Her Quiet Ranch Life
metaDescription: Amber Marshall, known as Amy Fleming on Heartland, has been married to photographer Shawn Turner since 2013 and shares a quiet ranch life near Calgary.
author: Mia Carter
altText: Amber Marshall and Shawn Turner at their ranch near Calgary with animals
html:
Amber Marshall has spent years in front of the camera as Amy Fleming on the beloved series Heartland, but her life away from the set looks nothing like the drama of television. The actress has been married to photographer Shawn Turner since July 27, 2013, and the two share a quiet ranch life near Calgary, surrounded by animals. It is a life that feels miles away from the spotlight, and Marshall seems perfectly content with that.

Amber Marshall and Shawn Turner: A Love Rooted in Ranch Life

While fans know her best as the horse whisperer of Heartland, Marshall's real-life romance has its own enduring quality. She and Turner tied the knot more than a decade ago, and their partnership has quietly thrived out of the public eye. The couple's home base near Calgary keeps them close to the landscapes that have defined Marshall's on-screen world, but their daily rhythm is their own.

Their ranch is filled with animals, a detail that hardly surprises anyone who has followed Marshall's career. She has long been associated with horses and rural life, both on screen and off. For her, the setting is not a performance. It is simply home.

Why the Heartland Star Keeps Her Marriage Low-Key

Marshall rarely talks about her private life in interviews, and Turner stays behind the lens rather than in front of it. That choice appears deliberate. The two have built a marriage that does not depend on red carpets or headlines. Instead, it revolves around shared quiet, open space, and a deep love for animals.

It is a refreshing contrast to the typical celebrity narrative. Marshall has carved out a career in one of Canada's most successful television exports while keeping her personal world grounded. The ranch near Calgary is not just a backdrop. It is the center of her life with Turner.

Amy Fleming on Screen, Amber Marshall at Home

Heartland has made Marshall a familiar face to millions. The series follows a family navigating life on a horse ranch, and Marshall's Amy Fleming has been at its heart. That role has given her a unique platform, but she has never let it swallow her identity. When the cameras stop, she returns to the same kind of environment her character calls home.

The overlap between fiction and reality is part of what makes Marshall's story so appealing. She is not playing a rancher on television and living a completely different life off set. Her marriage to Turner and their animal-filled property suggest a genuine alignment between who she is and what she portrays.

What Keeps Amber Marshall and Shawn Turner Going

Longevity in any marriage takes work, especially when one partner is in the public eye. Marshall and Turner have managed it by keeping things simple. They married in 2013, settled near Calgary, and built a life around animals and each other. No elaborate announcements, no constant updates. Just a steady, quiet partnership.

For fans of Heartland, that stability is part of Marshall's charm. She brings authenticity to Amy Fleming because she understands the world her character inhabits. And when she goes home to Shawn Turner and their ranch, she steps back into a life that clearly suits her.
